officialName: Application for Registration of Patent Agent
purpose: Apply for registration as a patent agent, enclosing a character certificate, declaring freedom from disqualifications, and providing personal details and qualifications.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries numbered instructions (1-5); right column is the form. The applicant is a prospective patent agent (an individual), NOT a patent applicant, so autofill from uploaded patent documents does not apply — the form is filled from the person's own details.

fields.text: I beg to apply for registration as a patent agent under the Patents Act, 1970.

fields.label: Character certificate from
fields.helpText: Instruction 1: the certificate testifying to the applicant's character should be from a person not related to the applicant and being a Gazetted Officer or any other person whom the Controller thinks fit.

validation.message: Name the person providing the character certificate.

fields.text: I hereby declare that I am not subject to any of the dis-qualifications specified in rule 114 of the Patents Rules 2003 and that the information given below is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

sections.title: Personal Details
sections.description: Instruction 2: name in full, family/principal name first.

sensitive.note: Residential address of the prospective agent.

validation.message: Enter your principal place of business.

fields.label: Address of the branch office, if any

sensitive.note: Date of birth; handle as sensitive personal data.
Place of birth; handle as sensitive personal data.

sections.title: Qualifications for Registration
sections.description: Instruction 3: particulars of qualification for registration as a patent agent.

fields.label: Particulars of qualification
fields.helpText: List each qualification, as printed items (a), (b), (c). Original certificates/attested copies are enclosed.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed
fields.helpText: Signed by the applicant personally (the applicant is the prospective agent).

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

attachments.label: Certificate of character from an unrelated Gazetted Officer / person the Controller thinks fit
Original certificates / attested copies of the qualification documents
Specimen signature on a separate sheet

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Attach two recent passport size photographs.
Note. - Provide specimen signature in separate sheet.
This is not a patent-applicant form: autofill from uploaded patent documents does not apply; it is filled from the prospective agent's own details.
Sensitive personal data (date/place of birth, father's name, residential address, photographs) must be handled accordingly.
